items.exampleEn: The news heightened her fears about losing her job.
items.exampleZh: 這個消息加深了她對失業的恐懼。

items.exampleEn: Two hours of practice a day should suffice.
items.exampleZh: 一天練習兩個小時應該就夠了。

items.exampleEn: Bulky items such as old beds are collected on Fridays.
items.exampleZh: 舊床這類大型物品在星期五收運。

items.exampleEn: The cost of the new stadium was a staggering sum.
items.exampleZh: 新體育場的造價是一筆驚人的金額。

items.exampleEn: The book was immensely popular with teenagers.
items.exampleZh: 這本書在青少年之間非常受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The risk of rain today is negligible.
items.exampleZh: 今天下雨的機率微乎其微。

items.exampleEn: False stories can proliferate quickly on social media.
items.exampleZh: 不實的消息可能在社群媒體上迅速擴散。

items.exampleEn: The train arrived marginally late, by about two minutes.
items.exampleZh: 火車稍微誤點了，大約晚了兩分鐘。

items.exampleEn: From the small boat, the ocean seemed limitless.
items.exampleZh: 從小船上望去，大海彷彿無邊無際。

items.sentenceEn: A short email will suffice; there is no need to call.
items.sentenceZh: 寄一封簡短的電子郵件就夠了，不必打電話。

items.audioEn: The sofa was too bulky to fit through the door, so we had to take off its legs.
items.audioZh: 沙發太大了，搬不進門，所以我們只好把沙發腳拆掉。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼得拆掉沙發腳？
options: It was too heavy to lift

items.sentenceEn: Small coffee shops have proliferated in this area.
items.sentenceZh: 這一帶的小咖啡館數量激增。

items.sentenceEn: We enjoyed our trip to the mountains immensely.
items.sentenceZh: 我們非常享受這趟山區之旅。

items.stemEn: The difference in price is ____, only a few cents.
items.stemZh: 價差微不足道，只有幾分錢。

items.stemEn: Bright lights and loud music ____ the excitement before the game.
items.stemZh: 明亮的燈光和響亮的音樂提升了賽前的興奮感。

items.passageEn: The number of electric scooters in our city has grown at a staggering rate. Five years ago, there were only a few hundred; now there are tens of thousands. Rental companies have proliferated, and some people believe the market is limitless. However, the scooters are bulky and often block sidewalks, and photos of them lying on the ground have circulated widely online. Renting one is also only marginally cheaper than taking the bus, and their effect on traffic has been negligible. Accidents have heightened public concern about safety. Still, many young workers find them immensely convenient for short trips.
items.passageZh: 我們城市裡的電動滑板車數量以驚人的速度成長。五年前只有幾百台，現在已經有好幾萬台。租車公司激增，有些人認為這個市場沒有極限。然而，滑板車又大又笨重，常常擋住人行道，它們倒在地上的照片也在網路上廣為流傳。租一台也只比搭公車便宜一點點，對交通的影響則微不足道。一些事故讓大眾更加擔心安全問題。儘管如此，許多年輕上班族覺得短程移動用滑板車非常方便。

questions.questionZh: 電動滑板車的價格和公車相比如何？
許多年輕上班族怎麼看電動滑板車？

items.promptZh: 這次漲價只比去年的稍微高一點。
referenceEn: This price rise is only marginally higher than last year's.
The price increase is only marginally bigger than the one last year.
rubricZh: marginally＋比較級表示「稍微⋯一點」（例如 marginally higher 等）
「漲價」可寫，例如 price rise、price increase 等
比較對象可寫，例如 last year's、the one last year 等

items.promptZh: 小孩子的想像力似乎是無限的。
referenceEn: Children's imagination seems to be limitless.
The imagination of young children appears limitless.
rubricZh: 「無限的」用 limitless（例如 seems limitless 等）
「小孩子」可寫，例如 children、young children、kids 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: inexhaustible 換成本課 staggering（與 only a few cents 矛盾）；bulky 只留在 q14

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q15 bulky 與 q14 同課重複，且只有一個干擾項放得進動詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 alleviate、discard（u03 及物動詞，放得進空格但語意不通）與 marginally
